title: Teams & Shows
subtitle: A shared space for bands, choirs and classes: scores, shows, assignments
planRequired: A Team plan is required to create a team
planRequiredNote: Creating a team needs a Team plan (Team Pro or Team Premium). You can still join a team when invited.
emptyTitle: You are not in any team yet
emptyHint: Create a team or ask your team lead for an invitation.

roleHint.OWNER: Full control over the team and all of its scores.
roleHint.MANAGER: Invites members, creates shows, assigns work; owns every team score.
roleHint.ARRANGER: Edits the songs assigned to them; other songs are view and comment only.
roleHint.VIEWER: Can only view scores and shows.

form.name: Team name
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Who you are, what you rehearse...

invite.title: {name} invited you to join
invite.expires: The invitation is valid until {date} and works only once.
invite.alreadyMember: You are already in this team.
invite.emailMismatch: This invitation was sent to {email}. Sign in with that account to accept it.

state.INVALID: The invitation link is wrong or was removed.
state.EXPIRED: The invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
state.USED: This invitation has already been used.
state.REVOKED: The invitation was revoked or declined.

tasks.title: My show tasks
tasks.empty: Nothing to arrange or review right now.

detail.deleteMessage: Delete “{name}”. Everything is kept and you can restore it within 30 days; members will no longer see the team.
detail.leaveMessage: You will leave “{name}” and lose access to its scores (except your own).
detail.notFoundHint: The team doesn't exist or you are no longer a member.
detail.planInactive: The team creator's Team plan has expired: the team still works, but no new members can be invited.

scores.hint: Shared scores of the team. Managers own every score; arrangers edit the songs assigned to them in a show.
scores.emptyTitle: No scores in this team yet
scores.emptyHint: Members move their personal scores into the team to use them in shows.
scores.removeTitle: Move score out of the team?
scores.removeMessage: “{title}” goes back to its owner as a personal score and leaves every show of the team.
scores.removed: Score moved out of the team
scores.removeFailed: Could not move the score out
scores.addTitle: Move my scores into the team
scores.addHint: Only your personal scores (not in any team) can be moved. You stay the owner.
scores.noCandidates: No personal scores left to move.

shows.hint: Each show is a performance: a song list, arrangers, reviewers and due dates.
shows.emptyHint: Team managers create a show and add songs from the team's scores.

members.countLimit: {count}/{limit} members (pending invitations count when inviting more)
members.roleHint: Arrangers edit assigned songs; viewers can only view. Invitations last 7 days and work once.
members.linkHint: Send this link to the person you are inviting. Anyone with it can use it once; it expires in 7 days.
members.removeMessage: {name} will leave the team and be unassigned from every song.

board.deleteMessage: Delete “{name}”. Its song list and assignments are kept and can be restored within 30 days.
board.dragHint: Drag a card to another column to change its status (only columns you may move it to light up).
board.orderHint: Managers drag or use ↑ ↓ to change the running order.
board.emptyTitle: This show has no songs yet
board.emptyHint: A team manager will add songs and assign them.
board.emptyHintManager: Click “Add song” to pick a team score and assign an arranger and a reviewer.

item.removeMessage: “{title}” leaves this show (the score stays in the team).
item.noScores: Every team score is already in this show. Move more scores into the team on the Scores tab.

trash.title: Deleted teams
trash.hint: Teams you deleted can be restored for 30 days after deletion.
trash.showsHint: Restorable for 30 days after deletion, with their song list and assignments.
